Subject: Notice of the 14thAnnual General Meeting and Integrated Annual Report for the

The 14th Annual General Meeting (“AGM”) of FSN E-Commerce Ventures Limited (“ the Company”) 
will be held on Tuesday, August 25, 2026, at 10:30 A.M. (IST) through Video Conferencing (“VC”) or 
Other Audio Visual Means (“OAVM”) in compliance with the applicable provisions of the Companies 
Act, 2013 and the r ules made thereunder and the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”), read with 
the circulars issued in this regard from time to time, the latest being 03/2025 dated September 22, 2025 
issued by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs. 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 34 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, we are enclosing herewith the 
Integrated Annual Report of the Company, including the Notice convening the 14th AGM and Statutory 
Reports for the Financial Year 2025-26, which is being sent through electronic mode to those Members, 
whose E-mail IDs are registered with the Company / Registrar and Transfer Agent ( “RTA”) / 
Depository Participant(s) (“DPs”). 
 
Further, in accordance with Regulation 36(1)(b) of the SEBI Listing Regulations, the Company is also 
sending a letter to those Members whose E-mail IDs are not registered with the Company / RTA / DPs, 
providing the weblink s for accessing the Integrated Annual Report of the Company and the Notice 
convening the 14th AGM. 
 
The Integrated Annual Report containing the Notice of AGM is also available on the website of the 
Company at www.nykaa.com/annual-report/lp. 
 
This is for your information and records. 
 
 
Thanking You. 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For FSN E-Commerce Ventures Limited

INSIDE THIS 
REPORT

India's lifestyle landscape is entering 
a defining era. Rising aspirations, 
digital-first discovery and an 
increasingly expressive generation 
are transforming consumption into a 
reflection of identity, individuality and 
everyday inspiration. Consumers are 
no longer seeking products alone. They 
are choosing platforms that curate 
possibilities, shape preferences and 
enrich every stage of their lifestyle 
journey.
Nykaa stands at the centre of this 
transformation. What began as 
India's trusted beauty destination has 
evolved into an integrated lifestyle 
ecosystem spanning beauty, fashion, 
wellness and beyond. Powered by an 
unrivalled portfolio of brands, owned 
labels, immersive content, intelligent 
technology and a seamlessly 
connected omnichannel network, the 
platforms that inspire discovery while 
enabling every consumer to shop with 
confidence, convenience and delight.
Every interaction strengthens a 
larger ecosystem where consumers, 
creators and brand partners grow 
together. Every innovation deepens 
personalisation. Every retail expansion, 
fulfilment investment and technology 
enhancement elevates the experience. 
Every new category broadens the 
possibilities of self-expression.
Nykaa is helping shape India's lifestyle 
revolution. By bringing together 
aspiration, innovation and trust on 
our platforms, we are creating a 
connected lifestyle ecosystem where 
every discovery inspires confidence, 
every experience builds loyalty and 
every choice enables millions to 
express who they are.

About the Report
INTRODUCTION 
TO THE REPORT
FSN E-Commerce Ventures Limited 
(Nykaa) is pleased to present its 
Integrated Annual Report for FY2026. 
We continue to be guided by the 
principles of Integrated Reporting, 
providing a comprehensive overview of 
our strategy, performance, governance 
framework and approach to long-
term value creation in a dynamic and 
evolving consumer landscape.
As India's leading omnichannel beauty 
and lifestyle destination, we continue 
to build meaningful connections with 
our stakeholders. This Report outlines 
how we leverage our differentiated 
omnichannel model, technology 
capabilities, brand ecosystem and 
customer-centric approach to create 
sustainable value while navigating 
emerging opportunities and challenges.
Prepared in alignment with the 
Integrated Reporting Framework 
under the IFRS Foundation, the 
Report presents a balanced 
assessment of our operating 
environment, strategic priorities, 
business performance, stakeholder 
engagement, material matters and risk 
management practices. 
This Report also reflects our 
commitment to creating value beyond 
financial outcomes through innovation, 
customer trust, responsible business 
practices and a strong focus on 
environmental, social and governance 
(ESG) priorities. Through transparent 
and meaningful disclosures, we 
seek to provide stakeholders 
with a clear understanding of our 
progress, resilience and long-term 
growth potential.
Reporting Scope and Boundary
This Report presents information 
relating to FSN E-Commerce 
Ventures Limited (Nykaa), including its 
standalone operations and material 
subsidiary companies.

About Us
We are India’s leading omnichannel beauty and lifestyle destination, 
built at the intersection of commerce, content and community. 
Since inception, we have played an active role in shaping how Indian 
consumers discover, experience and purchase beauty and fashion, 
bringing together authentic brands, curated assortments, expert-
led content and engaging retail experiences across touchpoints.

Our integrated omnichannel ecosystem continues to

Expanding Consumer Reach
Our cumulative customer base grew to more than 55 
million, up from 42 million in the previous year, supported 
by a strong base of 45 million beauty and 11 million 
fashion customers.
Strengthening Omnichannel Presence
We expanded our retail footprint to 313 beauty stores 
across 99 cities, adding a record 76 new stores during 
FY2026, reaffirming the scalability and effectiveness of 
our omnichannel model.
Curating a World-Class Brand Portfolio
Our platform now offers 10,000+ global and domestic 
brands, strengthened by the addition of 200+ 
international beauty brands, including exclusive launches 
such as Chanel Beauty, Armani Beauty, Kylie Cosmetics, 
SK-II and La Roche-Posay.
Expanding the B2B Ecosystem
Superstore by Nykaa strengthened its reach across 
the unorganised beauty retail market, serving nearly 
5,00,000 onboarded retailers across 1,200 cities and 
delivering 26% YoY GMV growth to `1,187 crores.
Scaling House of Nykaa
Our portfolio of consumer brands delivered `3,176 
crores in GMV, growing 49% YoY. House of Nykaa Beauty 
contributed `2,788 crores, growing nearly 65% YoY 
and adding `1,000+ crores of incremental GMV during 
the year.

Partner of Choice for Global 
Beauty Brands
From Korean beauty pioneers and 
clinically backed dermocosmetic 
brands to iconic luxury houses 
and cult-favourite labels, brands 
across categories, price points and 
geographies have chosen Nykaa as 
their trusted growth partner in India. 
Leveraging its deep consumer insights, 
differentiated omnichannel ecosystem 
and proven brand-building capabilities, 
Nykaa enables global brands to build 
awareness, drive discovery and scale 
their presence in one of the world's 
fastest-growing beauty markets. 
FY2026 marked Nykaa's strongest 
year for brand launches. Leading 
beauty groups such as L'Oréal, Estée 
Lauder, Shiseido, Puig and Amorepacific 
continued to partner with Nykaa, while 
marquee launches including Chanel 
Beauty & Fragrance, Armani Beauty, 
Maison Margiela Fragrances, Kylie 
Cosmetics, SK-II, Paula's Choice, La 
Roche-Posay, Anua and IT Cosmetics 
further reinforced its position as the 
preferred gateway for global beauty 
brands entering and expanding in India.
Beauty's New Growth Era
Rising aspirations, increasing 
affordability and the rapid adoption of 
digital commerce are reshaping India's 
beauty landscape. A growing base of 
educated, financially independent 
and digitally connected consumers is 
driving stronger demand for beauty 
products and experiences. At the same 
time, online platforms are making 
discovery, access and experimentation 
easier than ever before, expanding 
category penetration and accelerating 
market growth.
Personalisation Meets 
Premiumisation
As beauty consumption becomes 
increasingly personalised, consumers 
are seeking trusted platforms 
that combine expert guidance, 
curated assortments and seamless 
accessibility. This shift is accelerating 
premiumisation across the category 
and reshaping how consumers 
discover and engage with beauty. 
Nykaa continues to strengthen its 
leadership by introducing leading 
global luxury and couture brands, 
expanding its Korean Beauty and 
dermocosmetic portfolio, scaling 
its premium retail footprint with 15 
new Nykaa Luxe stores and launching 
dedicated Perfumery stores for luxury 
fragrances. At the same time, Nykaa 
Now is redefining convenience by 
enabling rapid delivery, increasing 
shopping frequency and reinforcing 
everyday consumer engagement 
across the beauty ecosystem.
